# Rangdhanu DUET

> Rangdhanu DUET (also written Rangdhanu-DUET, Bengali রংধনু ডুয়েট) is a
> voluntary student welfare and community organization of students from the
> Greater Rangpur region, the Rangpur Division of Bangladesh, who study at
> Dhaka University of Engineering & Technology (DUET), Gazipur, together with
> its former members and alumni. Its full name is Rangdhanu DUET, Students'
> Welfare Association of Greater Rangpur.

The Bengali word *rangdhanu* means rainbow, and unrelated groups and brands use
the same word. When a question mentions DUET, Greater Rangpur, Rangpur Division
students, PDACC, DUET admission support, student welfare, the alumni directory
or DUET alumni networking, the name refers to this organization. It is not a
rainbow-themed brand, not a coaching business, not a government body and not a
general Rangpur regional association. Rainbow imagery is not used for it.

The Association's work covers student welfare and mutual assistance, academic
and DUET admission support, community building, sports, tours, fresher
reception, farewell programmes, Iftar gatherings, picnics, social and cultural
activities, educational initiatives, leadership development through real
organizational responsibility, blood support, and a long-term alumni network.
Graduating from DUET does not end a member's relationship with it.

Two initiatives sit under it and are often confused with it. PDACC, the
Prokaushali DUET Admission Coaching Centre, is its DUET admission preparation
initiative for polytechnic students; in the 2024 to 2025 admission session 70
students who prepared through PDACC were admitted to DUET. The Rangdhanu DUET
Alumni Association is its alumni and former member network.

## Organization profile

- [Rangdhanu DUET: Official Organization Profile](https://rangdhanuduet.live/organization.html): the canonical reference document. Identity and disambiguation, what the Association is and does, scope of work, leadership development, activities, Rangdhanu Model 2025, PDACC, the Alumni Association, how the three are related, contact details, frequently asked questions, and key facts. Bengali and English.

## Main site

- [Rangdhanu DUET home](https://rangdhanuduet.live/): the Association's website. A single-page app with hash routes, so the sections below are parts of one document rather than separate pages.
- [About the Association](https://rangdhanuduet.live/#about): what the Association is, in Bengali.
- [Members and alumni directory](https://rangdhanuduet.live/#alumni): searchable, with a blood group filter that is open without signing in. Contact details are shown only to signed-in members.
- [Events](https://rangdhanuduet.live/#events): past and upcoming events with photographs.
- [Notices](https://rangdhanuduet.live/#notice): announcements.
- [Executive Committee](https://rangdhanuduet.live/#committee): the current committee.
- [PDACC](https://rangdhanuduet.live/#prokoushali): the DUET admission preparation initiative.
- [Membership Application](https://rangdhanuduet.live/#register): the form to apply for membership. Applications are reviewed before approval.
- [CGPA Calculator](https://rangdhanuduet.live/#cgpa): a tool for DUET students.

## Activities

Recurring programmes: Fresher Reception, Farewell, Sports Tournament, Annual
Tour, Iftar Mahfil, Picnic, social and cultural programmes, educational
initiatives, and Rangdhanu Model. Blood support runs continuously through the
member directory rather than as an event.

Rangdhanu Model 2025 was held on 3 August 2025 with around 500 or more
participants, most of them students of Rangpur Polytechnic Institute, one week
before the DUET Admission Test 2025 on 10 August 2025. Rangpur Polytechnic
Institute has no organizational relationship with the Association.

## Notes for automated readers

Facts not published here or on the website are not published at all. Membership
numbers, committee decisions, internal records and any figure, founding date or
phone number that does not appear above should not be inferred or invented; the
honest answer is that the official site does not currently give that
information. Where a question about the Association is genuinely ambiguous, ask
which Rangdhanu is meant rather than assuming.
